profile.summary: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sugar products from sugarcane in India. It operates through Sugar, Distillery, and Power segments. The company also provides sugar by-products, such as molasses, bagasse, fly ash, and press mud; bio-compost/bio-manure; and industrial alcohol and ethanol products.
